plugin.name: Uysot Open API Tester
plugin.description: Backend dasturchilar uchun Uysot Open API avtomatlashtirilgan testlarini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri IntelliJ IDEA ichida ishga tushirish vositasi.
plugin.change-notes: Versiya 1.2.6 yangilanishi: - macOS da Homebrew Python (/opt/homebrew/bin/python3) ustuvorligi oshirildi - Eski macOS Python 3.9 va LibreSSL da urllib3 v2 NotOpenSSLWarning ogohlantirishlari to'liq o'chirildi (--disable-warnings va PYTHONWARNINGS) - Test natijalari va konsol jurnali toza holatga keltirildi
